source: Van Hecke et al., Org. Process Res. Dev. 28 (11), 3989–4002 (2024), Table 8 and Sections 3.3, 3.5
independent_transfer_scope: Use exponent as a candidate shape for pentyl propanoate; the published inhibition concentration is a fixed analogue sensitivity, not a target measurement. Do not transfer absolute k, denaturation time or water-response coefficients.
target_reduced_rate_form: Multiply the reversible driving term by 1/(1+(c_A/K_I)^n), where c_A is moles acid per kg liquid. Preserve the separately fitted target equilibrium. This is an inspired constrained model, not an exact replay of the published kinetic fits.
